notes:
Updates: VDBackup can now update itself without reflashing. Between releases it fetches only the files that changed (signed, content-addressed) instead of the whole package, and keeps the full zip as a fallback. A new Updates panel shows progress, lets you cancel, and checks on demand; updates apply on the next boot, with a metered-connection guard.

Reliability: backing up many apps at once no longer stalls. VDBackup now stops only the apps that are actually running first, and a cancelled or interrupted backup always releases its wake lock.

Restore: a restored app's network-access policy now applies immediately and sticks on custom ROMs.

Fixes: the per-app Back up button now follows the interface language; deleting a backup removes it cleanly and prunes the empty folders left behind.
